findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Volume is the larger source of error (52.09 yds from volume vs 46.73 from rate). Fix the volume model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We under-project attempts by 1.11 per player (projected 31.37, actual 32.49).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is over-projected by 0.1 (projected 7.19, actual 7.09).

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 57/146 (39.04%). Our MAE 60.05 vs the line's 55.36. The book is the better projection.
